name: Semantic Relaxation Substitution
description: Replaced explicit zero-time/already-completed explanations with descriptions of hypothetical relaxed scheduling environments (e.g., "idealized machine with unlimited simultaneous capacity and zero processing duration"). This forces the model to evaluate the impact of the relaxation on the schedule's critical path rather than pattern-matching the explicit zero-phase hints to simple array sums, while fixing the previous gate rejection by replacing "strict deadline" with "at or before time T" to properly encompass equality.
